positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated a new banking core into the Galileo financial technology platform. We used the banking core’s features to expose functionalities for fintech clients to build custom lending products to build their own lending services, such as BNPL. 

I also worked cross functionally to simplify and automate various release processes to help improve delivery speeds and improve software quality around the organization.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Worked Amazon Music's live and on-demand streaming infrastructure. I led and contributed to many projects related to transcode and delivery including:

- Ultra-High Definition audio streaming using Dolby Atmos and Reality Audio 360
- AAC and Opus encodings
- DASH and HLS streaming protocols
- DRM protection, including Widevine, Playready, and Fairplay
- CDN systems, including AWS CloudFront, Akamai, and Fastly

company.name: University of Washington, Department of Orthopaedics & Sports Medicine

projects.title: Gait-retraining Software
projects.description: Design and write a GUI in MATLAB that is capable of connecting to a Bluetooth accelerometer; then collecting, processing, and displaying acceleration measurements from the distal tibia of training individuals in real-time. The purpose of this program is to investigate the effectiveness of real-time visual feedback in gait retraining, which has tremendous potential to reduce risk of suffering tibial stress fractures.
